ai_language_tip: Khmer (km) is what staff speak, but Bageo's list lacks it; open in plain English and keep sentences short. Phnom Penh and Siem Reap hotels, clinics and banks handle English best.
english_ok: sometimes — Fine at hotels, international clinics, banks and tour desks; thin at markets, garages and small salons.
politeness: Soft voice and patience; staff may greet with joom reap suor; thank them by name; never press or sound impatient.
name_tip: Khmer names put the family name first and people are called by the given name with Lok (Mr) or Lok Srey (Ms); spell foreign names letter by letter.
phone_tip: Mobile numbers start 0 then a 2-digit operator code, 8–9 digits after the 0 (012 345 678); same number is usually on Telegram.
time_tip: Clock times are 12-hour with morning/afternoon/evening words in speech; confirm 'evening 7' versus 19:00 for dinner bookings.
number_tip: Prices come in US dollars and riel side by side (about 4,000 riel to the dollar is a common shorthand); always say which currency before a sum.
avoid_calling: Avoid 11:30–14:00 (long lunch and rest), after 20:00, and Khmer New Year in mid-April and Pchum Ben when many shops shut.
closed_days: Government offices close Sat–Sun; markets and shops open daily; Khmer New Year, Pchum Ben and the Water Festival close many family businesses for days.
booking_channels: Telegram is the everyday business chat; Facebook pages take bookings; payment by KHQR/Bakong, ABA or Wing; rides by Grab or PassApp; food via foodpanda or local apps.
voice_menu: Banks (ABA, ACLEDA) and telcos (Smart, Cellcard, Metfone) run Khmer/English IVR; small shops answer in person or reply on Telegram.
callback_habits: Shops and clinics confirm by Telegram message or a voice note rather than calling back; tour desks send a PDF ticket on Telegram.

activity.before_dialing_zh: 吳哥窟門票須在官方售票處或線上買；導覽、遊船與烹飪課多經旅行社或 Telegram 預約。

may_come_up.what: Angkor passes are sold only by the official ticket office

sensitive_asked.what: Guide wants the whole fee wired before meeting

usually_asked: Tour or class and start time

beauty.before_dialing_zh: 髮廊、美甲與按摩多以 Telegram 傳照片預約；觀光區按摩店多接現場客，價格常以美元計。

may_come_up.what: Salon asks for a dollar deposit for extensions or keratin

sensitive_asked.what: Insists on full transfer to a private Wing wallet first

usually_asked: Treatment and hair length or nail style

change.before_dialing_zh: 改期取消多一通電話或 Telegram 訊息即可；節日訂金常不退。

may_come_up.what: Holiday deposit is kept if cancelled the same day

sensitive_asked.what: Asks ID card number to locate the booking

clinic.before_dialing_zh: 私立與國際診所可電話或 Telegram 預約並講英語；公立醫院多現場掛號，較複雜病例常被建議轉往曼谷或胡志明市。

may_come_up.what: International clinic quotes the consultation fee in dollars
Doctor available only in the afternoon shift

sensitive_asked.what: Requests passport number or Khmer ID card details

usually_asked: Patient name as on passport or ID
Paying cash, card or via insurer

customer_service.before_dialing_zh: 銀行與電信客服有高棉語／英語語音選單，帳戶事項須本人。

may_come_up.what: Bank will not discuss the account with a third party

sensitive_asked.what: Asks account PIN, OTP or ID number

usually_asked: What went wrong with the service

government_school.before_dialing_zh: 行政手續多須本人到場；國際學校可電話或電郵洽詢，週末不接。

may_come_up.what: Procedure needs the applicant in person

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the child's or parent's ID details

home_service.before_dialing_zh: 冷氣、水電與清潔多打電話叫；地址常以街號加地標描述，公寓需先告知警衛。

may_come_up.what: Technician charges a call-out fee in dollars
Building guard needs the worker's name

sensitive_asked.what: Asks money before seeing the job

usually_asked: Street number plus a nearby landmark

hotel.before_dialing_zh: 飯店與民宿多經 Booking.com、Agoda 或 Telegram；入住須出示護照，旅館會依規定登記外國旅客。

may_come_up.what: Passport copy taken at check-in for police registration
Airport pickup quoted in dollars

sensitive_asked.what: Wants passport scan and card number sent by chat

usually_asked: Check-in and check-out days in Cambodia

inquiry.before_dialing_zh: 問營業時間、節日是否開門、能否掃 KHQR 或刷卡，店家多直接回答。

may_come_up.what: Confirms they accept KHQR from any Cambodian bank app
Closed for several days over Pchum Ben

usually_asked: Whether an item is in stock

pet.before_dialing_zh: 獸醫與美容多集中在金邊，可電話或 Telegram 預約。

may_come_up.what: Vaccination booklet needed for boarding

sensitive_asked.what: Boarding asks full prepayment to a personal wallet

property.before_dialing_zh: 租屋多看 Facebook 社團與仲介，房東習慣 Telegram 約看；租金以美元計、押金常一至兩個月。

may_come_up.what: Agent sends videos of the unit on Telegram
Deposit and first month in dollars

sensitive_asked.what: Fee demanded to reserve before viewing

repair.before_dialing_zh: 機車與汽車修理多直接到店，手機維修集中在市場攤位；零件價常以美元報。

may_come_up.what: Mechanic asks for a short video of the noise on Telegram
Original parts cost more than local copies

sensitive_asked.what: Wants parts paid in advance to a personal account

usually_asked: Motorbike or car model and plate

restaurant.before_dialing_zh: 金邊餐廳多用 Telegram 或 Facebook 粉專訂位，熱門河岸餐廳週末要早訂；金額常同時標美元與瑞爾。

may_come_up.what: Group booking for Khmer New Year wants a KHQR deposit
Manager offers to finish the booking on Telegram

sensitive_asked.what: Wants ABA account login or card digits to keep a table

usually_asked: Evening or lunch seating and the hour

shop_order.before_dialing_zh: 蛋糕、花束與節慶禮籃多以 Telegram 傳樣式下單並先付訂金。

may_come_up.what: Deposit via KHQR before the cake is made

sensitive_asked.what: Full payment to a stranger's account before any photo

usually_asked: Writing on the cake or card

takeout.before_dialing_zh: 小吃與咖啡可打電話或 Telegram 點後自取；外送多經 foodpanda 等 App，現金與 KHQR 都常見。

may_come_up.what: Says delivery runs only through the app
Riel change may be short for big dollar notes

sensitive_asked.what: Asks prepayment to an unknown wallet for a small order

usually_asked: Dishes, sizes and sugar or ice level

tracking.before_dialing_zh: 本地快遞多由騎手打電話或 Telegram 聯絡收件人；國際包裹以追蹤號查詢。

may_come_up.what: Rider will call when near the gate

sensitive_asked.what: Asks the pickup code from the SMS

usually_asked: Who receives it and their number

transport.before_dialing_zh: 金邊與暹粒叫車多用 Grab 或 PassApp；長途巴士與包車可電話或 Telegram 訂。

may_come_up.what: Driver prefers the booking through the app
Province trip priced per car, not per seat

sensitive_asked.what: Car hire asks passport and licence copy
